title: 问数控制台
note: 以下为脱敏模拟数据，仅用于展示「问题 → 检索 → SQL → 校验 → 结果」的交互，不代表真实业务数据。

questions.label: 渠道保费环比
questions.question: 上个月各渠道的保费收入环比
questions.answer: 上个月全渠道保费收入 3.12 亿元，环比 +5.8%。互联网渠道增速最快（+21.6%），银保渠道小幅下滑（-2.1%）；个险代理人仍是最大来源。
questions.sql:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT channel_code, SUM(premium) AS premium
  FROM dws_policy_premium_di
  WHERE stat_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
    AND stat_date <  DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    AND policy_status = '有效'
  GROUP BY channel_code
), prev AS (
  SELECT channel_code, SUM(premium) AS premium
  FROM dws_policy_premium_di
  WHERE stat_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 month')
    AND stat_date <  DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
    AND policy_status = '有效'
  GROUP BY channel_code
)
SELECT c.channel_name,
       ROUND(cur.premium / 10000, 1) AS premium_wan,
       ROUND((cur.premium / NULLIF(prev.premium, 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS mom_pct
FROM cur
JOIN prev USING (channel_code)
JOIN dim_channel c USING (channel_code)
ORDER BY premium_wan DESC
LIMIT 100;

checks.label: 口径命中
checks.detail: 保费收入 / 有效保单 / 环比

evidence: 指标平台：保费收入 = SUM(premium)，剔除退保与失效保单
同义词：保费收入 / 已赚保费 / premium_income
口径：环比 = 本月 / 上月 - 1，按自然月统计
表语义：dws_policy_premium_di 按 stat_date 分区，channel_code 关联 dim_channel

questions.label: 互联网退保率
questions.question: 上季度互联网渠道的退保率是多少？
questions.answer: 上季度互联网渠道退保率为 4.7%，高于全渠道均值 3.9%。主要集中在投保后 30 天内，建议进一步拆分产品与首期保费区间。
questions.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN policy_status = '退保' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
        / COUNT(*), 4) AS surrender_rate,
  COUNT(*) AS policy_cnt
FROM dws_policy_premium_di p
JOIN dim_channel c USING (channel_code)
WHERE c.channel_name = '互联网'
  AND p.stat_date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 quarter')
  AND p.stat_date <  DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE)
LIMIT 100;

checks.label: 口径命中
checks.detail: 退保率 = 退保件数 / 总件数

evidence: 指标平台：退保率 = 退保件数 / 承保件数，按保单口径去重
字段语义：policy_status 枚举包含 有效 / 失效 / 退保
时间口径：季度按自然季度，stat_date 为保单生效日

questions.label: 件均保费趋势
questions.question: 近 7 天各险种的件均保费
questions.answer: 近 7 天件均保费最高的是重疾险（8,420 元），其次为年金险（6,150 元）。医疗险件均 1,980 元，但件数最多，适合作为交叉销售入口。
questions.sql:
SELECT
  risk_name,
  ROUND(SUM(premium)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT policy_no), 0) AS avg_premium,
  COUNT(DISTINCT policy_no) AS policy_cnt
FROM dws_policy_premium_di p
JOIN dim_risk r USING (risk_code)
WHERE p.stat_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 day'
  AND p.policy_status = '有效'
GROUP BY risk_name
ORDER BY avg_premium DESC
LIMIT 100;
evidence: 指标平台：件均保费 = 保费收入 / 保单件数，按 policy_no 去重
字段语义：risk_code 关联 dim_risk，risk_name 为险种名称
时间口径：近 7 天按自然日滚动，含当日
